lines.1: A rain of shots poured down from above.
lines.2: The Princess could not dodge them--
lines.4: Without hesitation, I dove in front of her.
lines.9: I felt the heavy impacts, but no pain.
lines.14: Otome spun through the air and landed.
lines.15: 「I would call it mutual destruction, but... this is my loss.」
lines.16: 「I never expected you to use Leo as a shield.」
lines.17: 「That's wrong. I made myself her shield.」
lines.20: Her warm body heat reached me.
lines.22: 「The capacity to shield me and elevate me without an order... Yes, yes.」
lines.24: 「Would you protect me this way from real bullets?」
lines.25: 「It wasn't logic. The moment I thought you were in danger, my body moved.」
lines.28: Seeing her this happy made protecting her worth it.
lines.29: Fine. Next time danger came, I would definitely protect her!
lines.32: The Princess dramatically scattered rose petals.
lines.33: 「It was entertaining enough. It merely proved I am the strongest.」
lines.36: A shot came from the doorway.
lines.42: Yoshimi celebrated innocently in the rooftop doorway.
lines.44: 「That is enough. The final survivor is Sato-san.」
lines.46: 「Yes. Oh, that was scary. It's finally over.」
lines.48: 「I let down my guard after defeating a powerful enemy. She struck in that instant.」
lines.49: The Princess clicked her tongue and hung her head.
lines.52: Otome hung her head too, while Yoshimi celebrated behind them.
lines.53: It was a delightful tableau one rarely saw.
lines.55: 「Tsushima, you are useless after all. Once a shield, always a shield...」
lines.56: 「You can't cite some law at me. I was shot and count as dead, so I can't interfere.」
lines.57: 「You must protect me even as a demon from hell.」
lines.61: 「Feels like Yoppi let everyone else fight and took the prize.」
lines.62: 「Not at all. Our champion eliminated three people.」
lines.64: Gentle Yoshimi had taken out three people?
lines.68: 「Her accuracy was one hundred percent. She wasted no ammunition.」
lines.69: 「Indeed. She coolly assessed her ability and killed with admirable precision.」
lines.74: 「You have played enough. Sleep quietly tonight.」
lines.75: 「I will supervise them, so there will be no problem.」
lines.76: 「I wondered yesterday too. Where is Date?」
lines.77: 「He said sleeping with everyone was embarrassing, so he'd sleep elsewhere.」
lines.78: 「(His night job is the real reason.)」
lines.81: 「Would you like to sleep with me?」
lines.83: 「I will be waiting on the field.」
lines.89: 「It seems the age has finally caught up with me.」
lines.90: 「I have no idea what you're saying.」
lines.91: 「For years, scum have called me Fukahire and treated me like food. I endured the unbearable on my road as a man. At last, I sail into adulthood.」
lines.93: 「Why are you looking at me so tenderly?」
lines.94: 「Even if your love remains unrequited and you grow into a wizard...」
lines.96: 「Yes, yes. Ignore the strange person. Lights out.」
lines.99: 「Seen like this, the Princess is still just a child. Ahahaha!」
lines.101: 「He gets strange sometimes, but this is a new level.」
lines.102: 「Farewell, Leo. Older women are the future, my boy.」
lines.107: That is how she sees you, Fukahire. Is that fine?
lines.110: 「Why are you here, Director...? Don't tell me...」
lines.111: 「Your conduct today was unworthy of a man. I will spend the night teaching you chivalry.」
lines.112: 「Calling me out through a trick isn't manly either!」
lines.113: 「To my office! I will beat your spirit straight and make you a man overnight!」
lines.114: 「Damn it! My soul will never submit!」
lines.116: The lights had been off for thirty minutes.
lines.118: Fukahire was not returning, and Subaru was away at work.
lines.119: That made me the only boy here.
lines.122: Were those two fighting even in their dreams?
lines.128: I decided to step outside too.
lines.130: The air outside was hot and humid.
lines.133: 「I am sleeping in the council room.」
lines.135: 「The council room locks, so nobody but me can enter... Subaru is sleeping elsewhere too, correct?」
lines.136: Right. That was our cover story.
lines.138: 「Perhaps. I simply cannot sleep in front of other people.」
lines.140: 「How rude. I am a proper lady. I sleep neatly and do not snore.」
lines.142: 「I would say it is none of your business, but we are dating. I will tell you.」
lines.144: The Princess looked up at the sky.
lines.146: I could not identify the constellations, but the stars were beautiful.
lines.147: 「Because I never know where an enemy may be.」
lines.149: 「I never expose myself that way before others. Yoppi is the exception.」
lines.150: 「Come to think of it, I've never seen you asleep.」
lines.153: 「One must be. I dislike people standing behind me too, though reacting to that would make school impossible.」
lines.156: 「Then someday I'll become a man you trust enough to nap in front of.」
lines.164: The Princess headed toward the Dragon Palace.
lines.167: As her boyfriend, I had to try harder.
lines.168: But offering to join her in the council room might end the relationship instantly.
